backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing users, plans, invoices, events, and anonymous usage limits with Stripe integration and admin-only analytics.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing implemented frontend files, components, and test IDs for event logging, fingerprinting, and flow instrumentation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of per-file frontend summaries describing component behavior, event logging, and app logic.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation specifying deployment slug rules and validation for the frontend app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting metadata and loading the main React app.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Production deployment checklist covering build, deploy, verification, and security steps.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Smoke test guide detailing required route checks, authentication flow, and Stripe checkout verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the root layout, theme provider, and routes for all main pages using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Displays a login/logout button using Internet Identity with automatic error handling and state updates.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Handles invoice detail inputs, validation, VAT text logic, and navigation to the next step.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Shows a list of required invoice fields with pass/fail indicators and alerts for missing items.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Generates invoice HTML, runs risk checks, allows saving and PDF downloading with plan and quota checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Displays a modal summarizing invoice risks, warnings, and a disclaimer based on risk check results.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main app layout with header navigation, footer, analytics logging, and routing outlet.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only UI for configuring Stripe keys and settings via actor calls with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button that triggers Stripe checkout session creation, logs events, handles redirects, and shows processing state.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal shown when free usage limit is reached, logs CTA event, and links users to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Upgrade modal displaying Starter and Pro plans with features, logs CTA, and navigates to upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Banner showing remaining monthly invoice quota for free users based on account plan data.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Step UI for selecting customer country in VAT calculator, with Germany fixed as seller country.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Panel showing detailed and simplified VAT explanations with tabs and a Pro-gated PDF export.
Paywall dialog shown for Pro-only VAT explanations, logging events and linking to upgrade.
Visual stepper displaying progress through a multi-step VAT flow with active and completed states.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Component validating reverse charge proof, displaying check results, and logging allowed cases.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: React step form for entering VAT transaction details, handling customer type, VAT ID, service category, turnover, and logging events before advancing.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays calculated VAT results, legal notes, OSS relevance, reverse-charge info, and provides actions like export, invoice view, and upgrade prompts.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates deployment slug format at build time.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches and maps the user’s active subscription plan and monthly invoice usage via React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous daily usage counts with a free limit and provides an increment function using fingerprint-based identification.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates Stripe checkout sessions through the backend actor, validating returned session URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Computes a daily fingerprint and detected country from IP for analytics and usage tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Logs analytics events with fingerprint and country data using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, providing identity state and login/logout utilities.
Provides invoice listing, PDF/ZIP downloads, and CSV/Excel export operations via backend actor with React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Manages invoice-saving permissions based on account plan and provides a mutation to save invoices while refreshing related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Provides simple access flags for determining whether the user is on a paid or specific plan.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines queries for fetching the current user profile and checking Stripe configuration using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers, theme variables, dark mode values, utilities, and invoice watermark/print styles.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Declares fixed analytics event names and exports their type for consistency.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Fetches best-effort country and IP data from ipapi.co for analytics.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Formats and sends analytics events to the backend actor with device, page, and metadata info.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates a daily hashed fingerprint based on IP and user agent, with caching and SHA-256 hashing.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Builds the full HTML for an invoice, applying translations, defaults, legal text, and VAT calculation results.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns scenario-based default legal VAT text for invoices.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Performs invoice risk checks including mandatory fields, reverse charge proof, and scenario-specific warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates required invoice fields based on scenario and returns missing field information.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic German-to-English translation using a fixed dictionary and a heuristic German detector.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Implements German VAT calculation logic including small-business exemption, reverse charge, digital services, and historical rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed plain‑language explanations for each VAT scenario based on calculation results.
Provides simplified, kid-friendly explanations of VAT scenarios using the calculation result.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores historical German VAT rates and utilities to retrieve correct rates for any date.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re‑exports VAT calculation and explanation modules for easier importing.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Determines whether a transaction is relevant for EU OSS registration and explains why.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines system prompts and flow text used for Germany‑specific VAT calculation steps.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates if reverse charge can apply by checking VAT ID formatting and country match.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements the multi‑step VAT calculator UI, handling form state, VAT calculation, navigation, and analytics events.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Invoice list and download page with selection, plan checks, and PDF/ZIP/CSV/Excel export handlers.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showing VAT calculator features and quick navigation to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays payment failure message with options to retry upgrade or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows payment success, logs the event, refreshes plan data, and offers navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Subscription upgrade page listing plans and initiating Stripe checkout after authentication.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility to create a Blob from text or binary data and trigger a client-side file download.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, clearing, and persisting URL parameters using search, hash, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color system, animations, and enabled plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state for adding GDPR-safe event logging, fingerprinting, and upsell/limit features, including DB schemas and core feature requirements. Contains architectural notes and a list of existing feature specs with versioning.
